meta.name: baoyu-post-to-weibo
meta.description: Posts content to Weibo (微博). Supports regular posts with text, images, and videos, and headline articles (头条文章) with Markdown input via Chrome CDP. Use when user asks to "post to Weibo", "发微博", "发布微博", "publish to Weibo", "share on Weibo", "写微博", or "微博头条文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到微博
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布微博内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post to Weibo

howto.what: Claude 会用真实 Chrome 浏览器把文字、图片、视频填进微博发布页,或把 Markdown 文件排版成头条文章;内容填好后由你手动确认发布。
howto.when: 当你说“发微博”“写微博”“微博头条文章”等,或要求把内容发布、分享到微博时触发。

say.text: 把这段文字配这张图发微博:今天天气不错
say.note: 浏览器打开微博发布页并填好内容

say.text: 把 article.md 发成微博头条文章
say.note: 打开头条文章编辑器,填入标题和正文

say.text: 发微博:文字“Watch this”,附视频 clip.mp4
say.note: 在发布页填好文字和视频

howto.what_en: Claude uses a real Chrome browser to fill text, images, and videos into Weibo's post page, or to publish a Markdown file as a headline article. It only fills the content; you review and publish manually.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "post to Weibo", "发微博", "写微博", or "微博头条文章", or otherwise ask to share content on Weibo.

say_en.text: Post this text with this image on Weibo: nice weather today
say_en.note: Opens Weibo and fills in the content

say_en.text: Publish article.md as a Weibo headline article
say_en.note: Opens the article editor, fills title and body

say_en.text: Post to Weibo: text 'Watch this', video clip.mp4
say_en.note: Fills text and video into the post page
